spec_match.rationale: Tests the exact contract of CSSWG PR 13903: the computed value of overflow: scroll clip is no longer converted to hidden, and a clipped axis refuses script scrolls — both probed against a real overflowing element, not CSS.supports alone (which passes even on legacy engines and is explicitly called out as insufficient).

interactive.rationale: The test subject is a real pannable scroller; the re-probe button re-reads computed style and re-attempts the script scroll.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises computed-value truth plus the script-scroll attempt; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes three states: no-parse (very old), parses-but-legacy-converts (the subtle trap, correctly diagnosed on Chromium 141), and true clip.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5067363861004288 plus explainer, CSSWG PR, spec, and the use counter.

conformance.rationale: Suite mirrors this page: parse check flagged as insufficient alone, computed-value preservation, script-immovability (with the hidden control), horizontal axis still scrollable, and distinct serializations.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: computed 'scroll hidden', script moved the axis to 60px, verdict 'legacy conversion' with the CSS.supports-true caveat explained; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; emerald/amber verdicts on paper (AA); the test subject uses a repeating-gradient of theme colours.

accessibility.rationale: The scroller is a labelled, focusable region (keyboard-scrollable); probes are text pairs; status is aria-live.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Probe grid collapses under 640px; the subject is width-capped; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the true-clip verdict on Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: On a Chrome 153 build with the feature, the probe should read computed 'scroll clip' with scrollTop stuck at 0 and flip the verdict — re-verify then.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Scrollable regions need tabindex and an accessible name to be keyboard-operable.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The subject has tabindex=0, role=region, and an aria-label.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive probe grid small screens no overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Single-column collapse and capped subject width.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): on Chromium 141 the probe correctly diagnoses the legacy conversion — CSS.supports true, computed scroll hidden, script scroll succeeds — which is precisely the divergence the page teaches. Console clean at both viewports.
